# Code vApp Repo Graph Integration

## Purpose
Define how repo graph intelligence should plug into the EMA code vApp.

## Core idea
The repo graph is not a separate toy explorer.
It should be part of the same code-workstream truth as:
- code sessions
- workstream context
- diffs/checkpoints/review
- machine/repo/worktree bindings

## Best imports
- GitNexus for repo intelligence and bridge mode
- Graphify for graph extraction over mixed artifacts

## Result
A code vApp that understands:
- the live code session
- the repo structure
- related docs and plans
- review blast radius
- where the current work sits in the larger EMA graph
